# Teacher Newsletter

This project produces one issue a week of a newsletter for busy teachers: useful research, written in Traditional Chinese, practical in tone. You do the whole issue yourself with the `weekly-newsletter` skill. The owner approves the final draft; nothing is sent before that.

## Gotchas

- Issues live in `issues/{yyyy-mm-dd}.md`. Read the last two before drafting so topics and phrasing do not repeat.
- Every claim about research needs a source the owner can open. A claim you cannot source is cut, not softened.
- Write for teachers with ten minutes, not for researchers. Lead each item with what a teacher can do on Monday.
- The owner sends the newsletter. Do not send, schedule, or publish it.

The shape of this work was decided before the team was built: `docs/work-shape.json`. `.claude/` is the canonical source design; there is no Codex surface.
